_note: Shared worked-example inputs for FMS engineering item 4 (capacity, layout, simulation): guide docs/FMS system design/64_capacity_layout_simulation.md, tools/fmse/*.py, web/fmse4x*.js. All values are EXAMPLES. Analytic results must match EXACTLY between guide, tools and web. Discrete-event simulation (DES) results cannot match bit by bit (different random generators / math libraries): they are compared STATISTICALLY (means of 10 replications with 95 % confidence intervals must overlap). The existing web item 4 (web/fmse4.js: OEE waterfall, queueing chart, 2-machine buffer simulation, layout pairwise exchange, generic FMS simulation) keeps its inputs; this file repeats them and adds the deeper models.

_formulas.oee: run = plan - down - setup ; A = run/plan ; P = ideal*total/run ; Q = good/total ; OEE = A*P*Q ; TEEP = OEE*plan/cal ; speed loss = run - ideal*total - minor (>= 0) ; quality loss time = ideal*(total - good)
_formulas.mtbf_mttr: failures = events with type 'failure' ; MTTR = mean duration of failures ; MTBF = (production_time_h*60 - sum failure durations)/failures [min] ; A_inherent = MTBF/(MTBF + MTTR) ; Pareto of all stop minutes by reason, descending
_formulas.mm1: rho = lambda/mu ; Lq = rho^2/(1-rho) ; Wq = Lq/lambda ; W = Wq + 1/mu ; L = lambda*W
_formulas.mmm_erlang_c: a = lambda/mu ; rho = a/m ; P0 = 1/( sum_{k=0}^{m-1} a^k/k! + a^m/(m!*(1-rho)) ) ; C = a^m/(m!*(1-rho)) * P0 ; Lq = C*rho/(1-rho) ; Wq = Lq/lambda ; W = Wq + 1/mu ; L = lambda*W
_formulas.kingman_sakasegawa: Wq = ((ca^2 + ce^2)/2) * (u^(sqrt(2(m+1)) - 1)/(m(1-u))) * te ; CT = Wq + te ; WIP = ra*CT with ra = u*m/te
_formulas.breakdown_variability: A = MTTF/(MTTF+MTTR) ; te = t0/A ; ce^2 = c0^2 + (1 + cr^2)*A*(1-A)*MTTR/t0
_formulas.setup_variability: setup of mean ts and variance sigma_s^2 every Ns parts: te = t0 + ts/Ns ; sigma_e^2 = sigma0^2 + sigma_s^2/Ns + (Ns-1)/Ns^2 * ts^2 ; ce^2 = sigma_e^2/te^2  (Hopp & Spearman, Factory Physics)
_formulas.closed_laws: rb = min over stations of servers/D_k (per visit-weighted demand) ; T0 = sum of D_k ; W0 = rb*T0 ; TH_best(N) = min(N/T0, rb) ; TH_pwc(N) = N/(W0 + N - 1)*rb ; TH_worst(N) = 1/T0
_formulas.mva_seidmann: exact Mean Value Analysis for a closed network; a station with m servers and demand D is replaced (Seidmann) by a single-server queue with demand D/m plus a pure delay D*(m-1)/m. Start Q_k(0) = 0. For n = 1..N: R_k(n) = D_k*(1 + Q_k(n-1)) for queueing stations, R_d = D_d for delays ; X(n) = n/(sum R_k + sum R_d) ; Q_k(n) = X(n)*R_k(n). Units: minutes; report X in pallets per hour (*60)
_formulas.replications: R replications with seeds 1..R ; mean ; sample std s ; half width = t_{R-1,0.975}*s/sqrt(R) with t_9 = 2.262 ; CI = mean ± half width
_formulas.welch: warm-up: moving average of the replication-averaged output series with window w; warm-up ends where the curve becomes flat (visual; tools print the moving average)
_formulas.layout_cost: C = sum_i sum_j f_ij * d_ij ; d_ij = (|dx| + |dy|) * pitch (slot grid, rectilinear)
_formulas.pairwise_exchange: steepest descent: in each iteration evaluate every pair of slots (i<j, slot order), take the swap with the largest strict cost reduction (first found on ties), repeat until no swap reduces C
_formulas.slp_score: closeness rating values A 16, E 8, I 4, O 2, U 0, X -64 ; adjacency = rectilinear slot distance 1 ; score = sum over adjacent department pairs of the rating value
_formulas.aisle: one-way aisle = w_vehicle_or_load + 2*c ; two-way aisle = 2*w + 3*c ; AGV with personnel: + 0.5 m protective clearance each side where people walk (ISO 3691-4 idea)
_formulas.space: department area = machines*(footprint + operator & service area)*(1 + allowance) ; total = sum + aisles share
